## 6. Handoff and choice

Put the handoff files in `docs/design/<YYYY-MM-DD>-<name>/`, with a `README.md`
that says what each file shows and which parts are final. A handoff file is a
reference for the look and the behavior. It is not code to copy. After the
build, the owner picks the result from a before/after page (`docs/PLANNING.md`).
